questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Animals on the Farm?
choices: Each farm animal needs food, water, shelter, and care.
Only this cow munches grass and hay.
Only a sheep grows a thick, woolly coat.
questions.answer: Each farm animal needs food, water, shelter, and care.
questions.rationale: This cow munches grass and hay. A sheep grows a thick, woolly coat. Each farm animal needs food, water, shelter, and care. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Each farm animal needs food, water, shelter, and care.
